description: Read-only: list the vault's recipes, shaders, presets, components, and setlists with title, tags, and description so the agent can pick from the library without opening individual notes. Filter by category (kinds) and/or a substring query. Returns a flat items array and per-category counts. No TouchDesigner connection required — reads the local vault on disk. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

kinds.description: Which library categories to list. 'all' lists every known category.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on note title/tags.

name: browse_vault_library

counts.description: Number of matched items per category.

description.description: Frontmatter description, or first body line.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the note (e.g. Recipes/glow.md).

tags.description: Tags extracted from frontmatter, normalised to strings.

title.description: Frontmatter title, or the filename stem when absent.

vault_path.description: Absolute path of the configured vault root.

warnings.description: Per-folder read problems; browse continues on error.

title: Browse vault library
